post.originalText:
Opus 5.5 made tiny worlds. Sonnet 5.5 made a character.

Same prompt: 20 frames of the Claude Code mascot, rebuild it in three.js. One try each, no fixes. Opus on top.

→ Opus, 27 min: every keycap holds a world with water, snow and lava
→ Sonnet, 15 min: the creature reads in every single shot
→ Opus built the giant out of 700 tiny creatures, watch 0:18
→ then Opus lost its own mascot in the grass

Fan-made recreation. Neither model saw its page run, I only rendered what they wrote.

be honest, which one would you ship?

sourceMaterials.text: @staysapien honestly a bit of both. still frame flatters it, but the motion holds up better than i expected for 20 frames
